fusions.name: Warm Breath
fusions.desc: Breathes a warm gust into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage. 15% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 4 seconds. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Herd Rolls On
fusions.desc: Rolls through every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 26 damage to each. Every hit is a critical hit, and its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles (max 40%).

fusions.name: Steady Pace
fusions.desc: Increases your health recovery by 50% for 20 seconds, and your movement speed rises 15% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Browsing Gait
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, you regain 2 health a second for 6 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
